title: [IMP-29] Configure append-only PPAP discussion
description:
Source task
PPAP implementation plan / IMP-29

Source plan
docs/phase 2/ppap/solution_specification/implementation-plan.json; plan date 2026-11-17; SHA-256 16059e862dd86c29ccbe374cabe8c001bbdab4667e74f46dadf2122b8f479d54

Task ID
IMP-29

Title
Configure append-only PPAP discussion

Category
Conversation

Objective
Keep supplier-visible and internal conversation separate and preserve every posted correction.

Detailed scope
Add Discussion Thread/Post fields, ordinary forms and posting actions with fixed thread audience, nonblank text and unchangeable posted files. Close all posting when PPAP is approved/cancelled and notify only authorized recipients.

Deliverable
Secured internal/supplier discussion with immutable posted content.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages
IMP-03 — Set up PPAP scope and the integrated part warrant
IMP-04 — Set up PPAP issue and approval facts

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.
• IMP-03 provides the PPAP facility/drawing/part/warrant fields and target due/display settings.
• IMP-04 provides the issue, review, replacement, cancellation and frozen approval/output fields.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: local thread/post fields, subject/body controls and fixed audience conditions can proceed; posting and protected supplier actor/file connections wait for the supplied methods.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
This work changes several related records or decisions. A Senior Consultant should configure its order and recovery behavior because an incomplete update could change approval history or expose the wrong work.

Fields and features to set up
PPAP Discussion Thread.PPAP
Create a link to PPAP, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP.Discussion Threads. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; creation action binds exact owning record; no later reassignment. Field/control lifecycle: Create Action Handler binds relationship in the authorized creation context; never user-reassign; preserve related-record history.

PPAP Discussion Thread.Subject
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Authorized participant prepares before first post; fixed after first post. Field/control lifecycle: Thread create checks PPAP open, record access and scope.

PPAP Discussion Thread.Internal Only?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: TRUE for internal author; FALSE forced for supplier author. Who can use it and when: Internal author chooses before first post; supplier forced FALSE/read only; fixed after first post. Field/control lifecycle: External thread requires authorized supplier-visible audience; internal content cannot become external.

PPAP Discussion Thread.Notification Recipients
Create the native multiple-selection link to Employee (M:N); inverse disabled. Use native link storage without a new Object. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Thread author/authorized participants select only users eligible to see thread while PPAP open. Field/control lifecycle: Notify on new post; membership never grants record access; native notification deduplication, no workflow tasks.

PPAP Discussion Post.Thread
Create a link to PPAP Discussion Thread, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Discussion Thread.Posts. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; creation action binds exact owning record; no later reassignment. Field/control lifecycle: Create Action Handler binds relationship in the authorized creation context; never user-reassign; preserve related-record history.

PPAP Discussion Post.Reply To
Create a link to PPAP Discussion Post, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Author chooses visible post in same Thread before Post; fixed afterward. Field/control lifecycle: Validate same Thread; no mixed visibility within a thread.

PPAP Discussion Post.Body
Set the type to Text; up to 8000 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Authorized thread participant before Post only; nonblank text mandatory including attachment posts; never edit/delete after Post. Field/control lifecycle: Post validates PPAP open; encode/sanitize rich content through native controls; corrections require a new reply.

PPAP Discussion Post.Attachments
Use the Intelex native attachment collection, retaining file identity, name, length and content type. Do not create a custom file table. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Author prepares before Post; append-only fixed after Post; same access as thread. Field/control lifecycle: Post freezes native attachment collection including additions/deletions; both discussion objects read only after PPAP Approved/Cancelled.

PPAP Discussion Post.Posted By
Create a link to Employee, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Post writes authenticated actor once; external supplier-to-native actor identity binding must be verified, no invented contact-to-Employee conversion.

PPAP Discussion Post.Posted At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Post writes server timestamp once; prepared drafts are not posted or notified.

PPAP.Discussion Threads
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Discussion Thread.PPAP; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

PPAP Discussion Thread.Posts
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Discussion Post.Thread; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

Build instructions
1. Configure Start Discussion and Post Reply for authorized participants only while owning target PPAP is open. A new thread requires Subject; each posted Body requires nonblank text even when files are attached. Reply To must be a visible post in the same Thread.
2. Internal authors may choose Internal Only? before first post, default TRUE; supplier authors are forced FALSE and cannot select internal audience. After first post freeze audience and subject, with every reply inheriting it. Never change internal content to external or allow mixed private replies in an external thread.
3. Before posting validate record/entity/classification access and eligible Notification Recipients; recipient selection grants no access. Stamp actual Posted By/At, then freeze Body and all attachments and publish the post event after successful save. Prepared content is not yet posted or notified.
4. Deny edit/delete/extra attachments on posted content; corrections require a new reply. When PPAP is Approved or Cancelled make both internal and supplier threads read only. Do not create workflow tasks from discussion.

How to check the result
• Supplier authors cannot create internal-only threads or use recipient selection to broaden access.
• Posted text/files cannot be edited/deleted, attachment-only posts are rejected, and all replies stop after closure.

Information needed for this task
IN-06: Supply supplier actor/recipient mapping and native visibility/record permission methods for the fixed internal/external thread boundary.
IN-13: Supply native attachment protection so posting freezes additions/deletions as well as file content.

Supplied input context
• IN-06 — Record visibility, file access and supplier actor connection: The security/technical team must supply visibility classification values and access rules, native record/file/API/export enforcement methods, authorized handover principals, and the supported external-supplier-user to native actor/recipient identity connection. This information limits the affected security, posting, confirmation and recorded-actor settings.
• IN-13 — Supported attachment limits and file controls: The tenant administrator must supply supported file sizes/types and the native method that protects posted/submitted files from editing or deletion. Average files are 1 MB, not an upload maximum. Ordinary attachments need no specialist viewer.

Specification references
• [Target PPAP technical specification](ppap-target-technical-specification.md)
• [Canonical target field contract](ppap-target-field-contract.md)

Assumptions and open questions
New operational PPAPs only. SIA PPAP Engineer means an internal SIA user; supplier personnel act through their separate supplier roles.
